message:
Just engaged? Put your date in and see what's due.

The free wedding checklist starts about 14 months before the wedding, which leaves time to book the venue and the vendors that sell out first. Less than a year away? Anything that should already be done is marked past due, so you know what to catch up on first.

No account needed: your ticks are remembered in your browser.

Try it free: https://bridalteam.com/wedding-checklist?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-03-noon-checklist-with-your-date
